name: Randi Brooks
bio: Randi Brooks was born on November 8, 1954 in New York City, New York, USA. She is an actress, known for The Man with Two Brains (1983), TerrorVision (1986) and Cop (1988). She has been married to Joseph Brazen since January 18, 1985. They have three children.
place: New York City, New York, USA
